acceptanceCriteria.description: Candidate archives from harness/evolution/pending.md are reviewed.
Proposal records an Experience Retention Scan covering Promote, Retain, Merge, Retire, and Archive-only decisions.
The final decision is recorded in harness/evolution/results.tsv and pending.md is cleared through harness-evolve mark-complete.
Any current-doc or template changes are minimal and justified by repeated archive evidence; if no durable delta is justified, result is noop.
Harness checks pass and handoff docs agree on active/pending/latest state before close.
